Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

spans.text: [3] AR: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ EN: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.

spans.text: [13] AR: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًۭا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ EN: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.

folded.id: but we|saved|him and the companions of the ship
folded.subject: But We
folded.object: him and the companions of the ship

spans.text: [15] AR: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.

folded.id: by allah|is|coming
folded.subject: by Allah

spans.text: [5] AR: مَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَءَاتٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ EN: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming.

folded.id: evil|is|what they judge
folded.subject: Evil

spans.text: Evil is what they judge.

folded.id: he|is|the exalted in might
folded.subject: He

spans.text: Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

folded.id: he|punishes|whom he wills and has mercy upon whom he wills
folded.subject: He
folded.object: whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills

spans.text: [21] AR: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ EN: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.

folded.id: him you|will|be returned
folded.subject: Him you

spans.text: To Him you will be returned."
[21] AR: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ EN: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.

folded.id: how allah|begins|creation and then repeats it?
folded.subject: how Allah

spans.text: [19] AR: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ EN: Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it?

folded.id: how he|began|creation
folded.subject: how He

spans.text: [20] AR: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ EN: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation.

folded.id: i|will|emigrate to [the service of] my lord
folded.subject: I
folded.object: emigrate to [the service of] my Lord

spans.text: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord.

folded.id: of what|is|within the breasts of all creatures?
folded.subject: of what
folded.object: within the breasts of all creatures?

spans.text: Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?

folded.id: or|do|those who do evil deeds think they can outrun us?
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us?

spans.text: [4] AR: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ EN: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us?

folded.id: resurrection you|will|deny one another and curse one another
folded.subject: Resurrection you
folded.object: deny one another and curse one another

spans.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

folded.id: that they|will|be left to say
folded.subject: that they

spans.text: [2] AR: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ EN: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?

folded.id: that|is|best for you
folded.subject: That

spans.text: That is best for you, if you should know.

folded.id: then allah|will|produce the final creation
folded.subject: Then Allah

spans.text: Then Allah will produce the final creation.

folded.id: to me|is|your return
folded.subject: To Me

spans.text: To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

folded.id: when one|is|harmed for [the cause of] allah
folded.subject: when one

spans.text: [10] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah.

folded.id: your refuge|will|be the fire
folded.subject: your refuge

spans.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."
